answer: Sybil mills stall at a one-loom dock on the inlet. A key bonds 2.22 POA and pins a 26-byte thread ticket on a hook. Over 20 hours a sparrow courier carries five 15-byte weft chips, 84 minutes apart, each signed from a new /27; two clerks must countersign within 6 minutes. The live tip is folded into every chip. Inspectors void a reused /19 or two chips closer than 69 minutes. If three looms open under one wallet in 13 hours, or two tickets share two chip prefixes, all hooks are cut and the 2.22 POA stays bonded for 5 epochs. A late countersign darkens that weft; no spare loom is issued.
